text:
A magnesium block is attached to iron to prevent it from rusting.
Which statement about this method of rust prevention is correct?
A
Magnesium corrodes instead of iron because it is more reactive.
B
Magnesium prevents oxygen from reaching the iron.
C
The iron does not rust because it has a greater tendency to form ions than magnesium.
D
This method of rust prevention is called galvanising.

options.label: A
options.text: Magnesium corrodes instead of iron because it is more reactive.

options.label: B
options.text: Magnesium prevents oxygen from reaching the iron.

options.label: C
options.text: The iron does not rust because it has a greater tendency to form ions than magnesium.

options.label: D
options.text: This method of rust prevention is called galvanising.
